page0.text:
...
It is a rapid stream of light that eliminates everything.
In the midst of that, the swordsman accepted the end of her battle.

page1.text:
"...This is the end. This is it for my battle."
Who was that addressed to?
The wielder of the sacred sword goes to her knees and gazes at the light with a flood of emotions.

page2.text:
The crumbling Holy Grail.
The thing that she sought, the thing that was supposed to save her.
She destroyed it with her own hands, and the King of Knights finally realized her mistake.
One boy and one hero.
That man, who had become twisted at the end of his ideal that he held for a long time, was still a boy.

page3.text:
His regrets are so heavy that they cannot be carried,
and his sins are so deep that they cannot be atoned for.
But there was something that he did not give up on.
At the very end, the knight in red has reached an answer that no one can affect.
Then... She has to move forward as well.
In her last moment, wounded, she took her hands off her sword.
She will run past that hill with her own will.

page4.text:
"...The contract is complete. Victory is yours, Rin."
The sacred sword fades.
There is still magical energy left.
She can stay in this world if she pushes herself.
If possible... she wanted to watch over what awaits them until the end.

page5.text:
"...However, that is not my role. Shirou has Rin."
The knight's body continues to fade until it vanishes, engulfed by the light.
